# Juan Nutrisyon calculation core

`index.mjs` and `manifest.json` are generated by the app-owned export in `nuxt-juanutrisyon`. Do not edit either file. Contract: `jn-nutrition-core-1` (ES2022 ESM, no runtime imports).

Only these nine helpers are public: `calculateFood`, `findNutrient`, `exactValue`, `parseAmount`, `isExact`, `normalizeBasis`, `normalizeHouseholdMeasure`, `normalizeDensity`, `convertEdibleWeight`. They preserve the existing app's full precision, source evidence, missing values, recipe completeness and import guards.

```js
import { calculateFood, findNutrient, exactValue } from './index.mjs'

const result = calculateFood(food, selectedAmount, selectedUnit)
const sugar = findNutrient(result.nutrients, 'sugar')
const grams = exactValue(sugar) // null means unavailable; explicit zero remains 0
```

Use `exactValue`, not a node's `amount` or `known_subtotal`, for an exact visualizer value. A partial recipe can have a numeric subtotal while its exact value is null. Pass the full food payload, including nested recipe inputs and `source_metadata`; do not deduplicate nutrients or bypass source guards. The default `calculateFood` unit is the food's declared source unit, so pass the selected unit explicitly when it differs.

Canonical household `gram_weight` maps to `normalizeHouseholdMeasure({ quantity, weight_in_grams: option.gram_weight })`; its `weight_grams` can then be passed with unit `g`. A supplied volume stays in mL; do not invent density. API serving-option selection and validation belong to the later portion adapter.

The manifest records the app commit, hashes/status of every loaded source/build input, tool versions, rendered modules and distribution checksum. Some hashed inputs (interpretation/reference modules and their snapshot) are inspected by the bundler and removed entirely. The runtime artifact includes ten calculation modules, including recipe retention, with no reference snapshot or framework payload. An uncommitted export is explicitly marked and hashed: the commit alone cannot reconstruct those changes until they are committed.

See [maintenance instructions](../../../docs/food-visualizer/shared-calculator.md) and the [Phase 3 report](../../../docs/food-visualizer/phase-03-report.md).
